recent: West River Berhad 于2026年11月17日公布季度业绩，净利同比增长90.4%至331万令吉。公司近期有多项公告，包括董事会及委员会成员变动，以及一项清盘相关公告。新闻显示公司正专注于提高合约赚幅。
notable: 2026年11月17日公布季度业绩，净利同比增长90.4%至331万令吉。
2026年9月1日宣布多项董事会及委员会成员变动，包括委任 Dato' Sri Dr Shahril Bin Mokhtar、Miss Tan Pei Shiun 及 Mr Chan Teng Chun。
2026年9月9日发布清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理人相关公告。
risks: 2026年9月9日出现清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理人相关公告，需留意后续发展。
2026年9月1日董事会及多个委员会成员出现变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为3943万令吉，环比下降0.5%，同比增长53.0%；净利为240万令吉，环比增长8.5%，同比增长134.5%；净利率为6.1%，高于上一季度的5.6%。

recent_en: West River Berhad announced its quarterly results on 17 November 2026, with net profit rising 90.4% year-on-year to RM3.31 million. The company has made several announcements recently, including changes in board and committee members, and a winding-up related announcement. News indicates the company is focusing on higher-margin contracts.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results on 17 November 2026, with net profit up 90.4% year-on-year to RM3.31 million.
Announced multiple board and committee changes on 1 September 2026, including appointments of Dato' Sri Dr Shahril Bin Mokhtar, Miss Tan Pei Shiun and Mr Chan Teng Chun.
Issued a winding-up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator announcement on 9 September 2026.
risks_en: A winding-up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator announcement was made on 9 September 2026; subsequent developments should be monitored.
Board and multiple committee changes occurred on 1 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM39.43 million, down 0.5% QoQ but up 53.0% YoY; net profit was RM2.40 million, up 8.5% QoQ and 134.5% YoY; net margin was 6.1%, higher than 5.6% in the previous quarter.
